structural_change: c10 (S-ELEM-PQ/BF 2026-10-16; c9 gate/route measured ck 13,185 sinks TT insertion 363 ps / spread 116 ps, CTS skew dominated by the two root ICG cones: u_fcg ENA low-phase latch 267 ps vs cloned ICG CLK 161 ps (routed reg->reg -35.7 ps at u_fcg ENA), u_ze -> u_cg ENA 140 ps; pins: W/E 776-bit buses packed into the middle 37% of the face at 10.4 pins/um, N 1,024-bit bus 10.4 pins/um on M5 only, clock entry at the SW corner, fill 0.632). STRUCTURE: (1) the static-programme core has NO clock gate: fclk = gclk = ck, one ungated balanced tree (u_fcg, its latch and the u_cg ICG removed); every former gclk register loads under its own kept copy of the registered gate enable (35 ot_v41_kreg u_cen, d = ze_d, async set on rst_n_pin like u_ze): exact by construction (an ICG passes edge t iff its low-phase latch holds ze_q(t-1), the value a data enable samples at t), 0 cycles; (2) outline 100.224 -> 116.64 x 198.72 (fill <= 0.60 incl. the enable muxes); (3) pins re-spaced by face with bit order kept: W/E over the whole face on M4 (4.0 pins/um), N/S alternating M5/M3 (N 4.6 pins/um per layer), ck + io_clk at the face centre. Pin registers: RTL registers every port at the pin already (recipe-3 synthesis pin_regs opted out with reason). Variant W: ck/io_clk at the W-face centre.

pin_regs.reason: RTL already registers every data port at the pin (inputs: PINREG pin flops on io_clk -> lockup latch -> core; f_prog programme_pin_q; qy0/qy1 dedicated face capture; outputs: CPIN seam flops on io_clk for c0/c1, st from registered busy/fault through source-ck lockups). A synthesis pin register would add a second edge on every port and break the fixed 1-edge seam contract (producer DELTA -1, c0/c1 column lockstep, 3-edge status pulse). Native audit of the routed view checks comb 0 pins.
